# Source: Bureau Secretary

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Bureau Secretary
- **Artist / culture:** David Roentgen (born Hesse-Darmstadt [now Germany], 1743–1807) Neuwied, County of Wied-Neuwied (now Germany)
- **Date:** c. 1775
- **Style:** Rococo
- **Classification:** furniture
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 80089
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/80089
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/7cee5861-b881-bbc0-40d6-1a2dc625d978/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Rococo

## Extracted source palette

`#D8D8D8, #482808, #683808, #B8B8B8, #885808, #585858, #886828, #684828`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#251504`
- `surface`: `#3E3021`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#885808`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#D8D8D8`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3021`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#605548`
- `error`: `#885808`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `cinzel` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `16.63:1`, surface `11.97:1`
- Variant contrast: `11.97:1`
- Control contrast: `5.73:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
